parallel_work_rule: 47 R1-only pending and 11 R2/R3 climate-data pending continue into R4 in parallel with their own evidence supplementation; do not block R4 on these supplements. If a candidate is later reliably excluded by R4, stop unnecessary earlier supplementation. If it passes R4, resume or complete earlier supplementation. Missingness never equals failure.
workstreams: R4.1 1km gridded long-term PM2.5 and ground-level ozone using inhabited-population weighting
R4.2 drinking-water source, treatment-plant outlet and household tap monitoring; keep sample scopes distinct
R4.3 industrial pollution sources, soil risk sources and historical remediation/violations with residential spatial overlay
R4.4 flood, landslide, debris-flow, seismic and other major natural hazard exposure at actual inhabited subareas
screening_principle: Only reliable evidence of severe, long-term and practically unavoidable exposure can support hard exclusion. City/province averages, raw source water, single-quarter tap samples, modelled grids and county-level flags are contextual evidence and cannot independently establish residential exposure or hard exclusion.
